tools.name: upscale_video
tools.description: Start upscaling a video to 1080p, 2k or 4k. Charges credits for the whole video (its length is read from the file) and returns the task. Downloading a large video can take a few minutes. If this call times out or fails, first call list_tasks to see whether the task was created, and retry only with t

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Get an upscale task. Status is queued, processing, completed (output_url is the result) or failed (credits were refunded). Set wait_seconds (up to 45) to wait for it to finish before returning; call again if it is still running.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List your upscale tasks, newest first, including ones started on the website.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Your credit balance and the price per second of video for each resolution.

tools.name: create_upload
tools.description: Get a signed URL to upload a local video file (up to 100MB) when it has no public URL. PUT the file bytes to upload_url with the returned headers (no Authorization header), then pass video_url to upscale_video. The URL expires in 1 hour.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_upload" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get a signed URL to upload a local video file (up to 100MB) when it has no public URL. PUT the file bytes to upload_url with the returned headers (no Authorizat…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_upload · Private data: upscale_video, create_upload · Public sink: create_upload.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_upload · Private data: upscale_video, create_upload · Public sink: create_upload

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
